featureRef: 27.3 Class placement of an admitted student
name: Place an admitted student in a class and section, and invite their guardian to its parent group
priorityReason: An admitted student is on nobody's register until they are placed. It is the step between admission and school life.

goal.capability: to place an admitted student in a class and section and bring their guardian into that section's parent group
goal.outcome: the child appears on a register and their family is in the right group, without anyone hunting for a link

secondaryActors.involvement: Places students, moves them between sections, and maintains the record as details change.
Receives the invite link to the section's WhatsApp group once their child is placed.
Sees the students placed in their own class and section.

externalActors.involvement: Delivers the invite link to the guardian and returns delivery status.

additional.description: An admission is confirmed and the student appears in the list awaiting placement.
A bulk import creates students without a class, which puts them in the same list.

preconditions.condition: The student record exists and is at status Registered, having been created when the admission was approved.
A class and a section with remaining capacity exist for the academic session.
An authenticated session exists and the acting user is School Admin, Staff or Accounts.
The guardian's contact is held on the student record, so the invite has somewhere to go.

establishedBy.name: View and maintain the student record

postConditions: The student holds a class and section for the academic session and appears on that section's register.
The record has moved from the Registered Student List to the Enrolled Student List for that class and section.
The guardian has been sent the WhatsApp invite link held against that section, and the send is logged with its delivery status.
The student becomes billable against the fee structure for that class, and markable for attendance from the placement date.
The class incharge and the coordinator of that class see the student in their own lists.
Where the student was moved from another section, they are off the old register, the move is recorded with its reason, and the new section's link has been sent.
Where the section held no stored invite link, the placement still succeeded and the absence of a send is recorded rather than passing silently.

businessRules.rule: Placement does not create the student record. The record exists from the moment the admission was approved, and this is what happens next.
A student is placed into a section, not into a class. A class holds no register of its own.
The class defaults to the one approved at admission. Placing into a different class is permitted and is recorded, because the family was told a class.
A section at capacity cannot take a further student. Placement checks the same capacity that admission checked, so neither route over-fills a section.
Placing a student moves the record from the Registered Student List to the Enrolled Student List for that class and section.
Attendance is markable for the student from the placement date, not from the admission date. A child admitted in August and placed in September was not absent for a month.

Moving a student to another section drops them from the old register and adds them to the new one, and requires a reason. The previous enrolment row is closed, not edited, so the history of where a child sat survives.

On placement the guardian is sent the invite link held against that section. Where the section holds no stored link, the placement still succeeds and records that no invite was sent, so the gap is visible rather than silent.
A bulk placement covers only students awaiting placement, and each is placed individually inside the batch. One failure does not abandon the rest, and each outcome is reported separately.

A student moved to another section is sent the new section's link. They are not removed from the old WhatsApp group by the system, because the system does not administer the group — somebody removes them by hand.
A placement is never deleted. A student placed in error is moved, with the move recorded and its reason kept.
A student may hold only one active placement per academic session. Placing them again moves them rather than creating a second enrolment.

transitions.condition: A class and a section with capacity are assigned (BR-4, BR-5).
The student is moved to another section, with a reason (BR-7).
The new enrolment row is opened for the receiving section.
The student leaves, is struck off, or the academic session closes.

basicFlow.userAction: Opens the list of newly admitted students awaiting placement.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Lists students at status Registered with the class approved at admission and how long they have waited.

basicFlow.userAction: Opens a student and selects the class and section.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Defaults the class to the one approved at admission and offers only sections of that class with remaining capacity.

basicFlow.userAction: Sets the placement date and places the student.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Checks the section still has capacity, then creates the enrolment and updates the section's placed count.
Moves the record from the Registered Student List to the Enrolled Student List for that class and section.
Sends the guardian the WhatsApp invite link held against that section, and logs the send with its delivery status. Where no link is stored, records that none was sent.
Puts the student on the section register, makes them markable for attendance from the placement date, and billable against the class's fee structure.

basicFlow.navigation: Login → Class & Session → Section register → Move student
basicFlow.userAction: Moves a student to another section where the school rebalances.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Closes the previous enrolment, opens a new one, and sends the new section's invite link.

alternateFlows.condition: A whole cohort is being placed at once
alternateFlows.behaviour: Students awaiting placement are selected, sections assigned, and each is placed individually inside the batch. One failure is reported and does not abandon the rest (BR-9).

alternateFlows.condition: The section holds no stored group link
alternateFlows.behaviour: The placement still succeeds. No invite is sent and the absence is recorded against the placement, so somebody can put it right rather than assuming the family was invited (BR-8).

alternateFlows.condition: The approved class is full in every section
alternateFlows.behaviour: The student is placed into a different class, which is recorded because the family was told a class at admission (BR-3).

alternateFlows.condition: A student is moved between sections
alternateFlows.behaviour: They are dropped from the old register and added to the new one with a reason. The new section's link is sent; removing them from the old WhatsApp group is done by hand, because the system does not administer the group (BR-7, BR-10).

alternateFlows.condition: The guardian says the invite never arrived
alternateFlows.behaviour: The stored link is sent again to that guardian and the send is logged, without re-inviting the section.

alternateFlows.condition: The student came from a bulk import rather than an admission
alternateFlows.behaviour: Imported students with no class appear in the same list and are placed identically. Only their origin differs.

exceptions.condition: The section filled between opening the screen and placing
exceptions.messageShown: Section B filled while you were placing. Choose another section.

exceptions.condition: The placement date is before the admission date
exceptions.messageShown: The placement date cannot be before the admission date.

exceptions.condition: The placement date is in the future
exceptions.messageShown: Choose a placement date of today or earlier.

exceptions.condition: The student is already placed in a section this session
exceptions.systemResponse: No second enrolment is created; the action becomes a move and requires a reason (BR-12).
exceptions.messageShown: This student is already in Grade 4 Section A. Give a reason to move them.

exceptions.condition: A move is attempted with no reason
exceptions.messageShown: Give a reason for moving this student.

exceptions.systemResponse: The placement stands and the send is marked Failed. It can be resent from the section register. A failed message never unplaces a student.
exceptions.messageShown: The student is placed. The group invite could not be sent — resend it from the section register.

exceptions.condition: No section of the approved class has capacity
exceptions.systemResponse: No section is offered for that class; another class must be chosen or a section's capacity raised.
exceptions.messageShown: Every section of Grade 4 is full. Choose another class, or raise a section's capacity.

exceptions.condition: The student record was deactivated since the list was loaded
exceptions.messageShown: This student record is no longer active.

exceptions.condition: The guardian holds no contact number
exceptions.systemResponse: The placement succeeds and the invite cannot be sent; the gap is recorded.
exceptions.messageShown: The student is placed. No guardian contact is on file, so no group invite was sent.

departures.requirement: Two users placing students into the same section at the same moment cannot together exceed its capacity.
A bulk placement of 200 students completes within 60 seconds, reporting progress and a per-student outcome.
A placement records what actually happened with the invite — sent, failed, or none stored — and never implies a family was invited when it was not.

openQuestions.question: Who removes a moved student's guardian from the old section's WhatsApp group?
openQuestions.assumption: Somebody by hand. The system does not administer the group (BR-10), and nothing enforces that it is done.

openQuestions.question: Should placement into a class other than the one approved at admission need Principal approval?
openQuestions.assumption: No, but it is recorded (BR-3). Not confirmed.

openQuestions.question: Should the guardian be told the class and section by message as well as the group link?
May a student be placed with a backdated placement date, and how far back?
openQuestions.assumption: Not before the admission date. No other limit is specified.

openQuestions.question: What happens to placements when an academic session closes — are they ended, or carried by promotion?
openQuestions.assumption: Promotion opens new enrolments for the next session. Not specified here.

conventionsApplied.name: session-and-authentication
conventionsApplied.rule: Every use case except the login use case assumes an authenticated session. Sign out is available on every screen. An expired or invalid session returns the user to the login screen with the message "Your session has ended. Please sign in again."

conventionsApplied.name: role-based-access
conventionsApplied.rule: Access is enforced server-side on every request, not only by hiding menu items. A request for a record outside the actor's permitted scope returns a 403 and the message "You do not have permission to view this record." A use case states additions and restrictions only.

conventionsApplied.name: branch-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every record carries a branch ID. Users see only their own branch unless the use case states otherwise. Super Admin, School Admin and Principal may switch branch from the header.

conventionsApplied.name: academic-session-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every academic record carries an academic session ID. Lists default to the current open session.

conventionsApplied.name: list-screens
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list supports search, column sort and page-size selection. Default page size 25; default sort is most recent first. Filters are applied before printing or exporting.

conventionsApplied.name: print-and-pdf
conventionsApplied.rule: Every report and list offers Print and Download as PDF, honouring the filters currently applied. Each output carries the school name, branch, academic session, report title, filter summary, generation timestamp and the name of the user who generated it.

conventionsApplied.name: audit-trail
conventionsApplied.rule: Every create, update, deactivation, approval and reversal writes to the audit log: actor, role, timestamp, record type, record ID, before and after values, and IP address. Audit entries are never editable.

conventionsApplied.name: deletion
conventionsApplied.rule: Records are deactivated, not physically removed. Deactivated records are excluded from lists and lookups but remain in the audit trail and in historical reports. A record referenced by a financial transaction can never be deactivated.

conventionsApplied.name: validation-and-messages
conventionsApplied.rule: Field-level errors appear inline beneath the field on blur and on submit. Errors that block the whole action appear as a banner at the top of the form. Successful actions show a toast. No action succeeds silently.

conventionsApplied.name: dates-times-numbers
conventionsApplied.rule: Dates display as DD-MM-YYYY; date and time as DD-MM-YYYY HH:mm in 24-hour form. Times are school-local. Phone numbers are stored in the registered mobile format.

conventionsApplied.name: language
conventionsApplied.rule: All user-visible strings come from a resource file. No hard-coded text in any screen.

conventionsApplied.name: concurrency-and-locking
conventionsApplied.rule: Last write wins, except where a use case defines an approval lock. Once a record is approved, posted or issued it becomes read-only and can only be changed through its defined reversal use case.

conventionsApplied.name: screen-states
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list, dashboard tile and report defines four states: loading, empty, error and populated. The empty state names what is missing and links to the action that creates it.

conventionsApplied.name: bulk-actions
conventionsApplied.rule: Any bulk operation reports a per-row result, commits valid rows and lists rejected rows with the reason. A bulk action never fails as a whole because of one bad row.

conventionsApplied.name: notifications
conventionsApplied.rule: All outbound SMS, WhatsApp, email and push messages are sent through the Messaging module, recorded in the sent-message log with per-channel delivery status, and use a named template. Use cases reference the template; they do not embed message text.

conventionsApplied.name: default-performance-and-retention
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise: a screen loads within 2 seconds and a save completes within 2 seconds at 200 concurrent users; lists paginate above 100 rows; financial and student records are retained 7 years; audit and message logs 12 months; every screen is usable at a 360 px viewport. Fill the non-functional field only to depart from this.

conventionsApplied.name: default-trigger
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise, the trigger is: the user navigates to the screen and initiates the action. Fill the Triggers field only where a scheduled job, an event in another module, or an inbound external call also starts it.
